title: Empty data elements with value representation SQ are set to None
body: In the current master, empty data elements are not read correctly from files. The attribute value is set to None instead of []. Expected behavior: create empty list [] for an empty sequence, i.e. a sequence with zero items. To reproduce: create a Dataset, assign AcquisitionContextSequence = [], write it as implicit VR little endian, read it back, and inspect the sequence value. The reloaded empty SQ value must remain an empty sequence rather than None.
